<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This file is a standard AUR `.SRCINFO` metadata file for the `ntfs2btrfs-git` package. It contains only package description, dependencies, versioning, and source information. The `source` field uses `git+https://github.com/maharmstone/ntfs2btrfs.git`, which is the package's own upstream repository — expected for a `-git` package. The `sha512sums = SKIP` is required for VCS sources per AUR conventions and is not a security concern. There are no `prepare()`, `build()`, or `package()` functions in this file, no network downloads beyond the git source, no obfuscated code, no `eval`/`base64`/`curl|bash` chains, and no suspicious system modifications. All dependencies (`fmt`, `zlib`, `lzo`, `zstd`) are standard libraries. The package description, license (GPL-2.0-or-later), and architecture (x86_64) are consistent with normal packaging practice.
</details>
